title: JSONMode preface validator and sandboxed tool-call integration tests
creator: Lena Chen
description: Create a focused test harness that validates strict JSONMode enforcement for model responses that include a required JSON preface (free-text header) and subsequent structured payload, ensuring constrained-decoding and tool-call compatibility across streaming and non-streaming paths.
background: We observe classes of failures in production when models emit a short human-readable preface (e.g., 'Result below:') followed by a JSON blob. Existing strict JSONMode validators assume the JSON starts quickly; this causes false positives and broken tool-call parsers downstream. Additionally, tool/function calling can interleave tool invocations with streaming partial JSON. We need deterministic tests that exercise the prefix+json pattern, constrained decoder backoffs, and sandboxed tool-call integration to avoid regressions when tightening schema enforcement.
goals: Ship an automated test harness that simulates model outputs with varying preface lengths and noise and asserts correct JSON extraction and parsing
Validate constrained-decoder behavior when a JSON payload appears after N non-JSON tokens (N up to 40)
Exercise streaming partial-chunk recovery when tool-calls are emitted mid-stream
Surface regressions across model variants (small/medium/large) and runtime kernel paths
Provide a set of CI smoke tests and a reproducible local runner for on-demand debugging
scope: Integration tests + harness, CI job definitions, test data corpus, and test documentation. Does not include production rollouts or changes to the production validator service at runtime.
out_of_scope: Changing production JSONMode semantics, dashboard visualization changes, end-user SDK API modifications.
success_metrics: CI test coverage for JSON-prefaced payloads >= 95% across defined scenarios
Zero JSONMode false-positive regressions on subsequent two runtime releases
Mean time to reproduce for reported prefaced-json issues < 24h due to reproducible harness
acceptance_criteria: Harness can synthesize model streams with configurable preface lengths and character distributions
Constrained-decoder allowed to back off and retry with relaxed token acceptance; harness verifies policy adherence
Tool-call sandbox in harness simulates kernel-side tool invocation and validates that tool outputs are correctly re-integrated into the structured JSON when the model expects the tool-return field
CI job added to 'schema-enforcement' pipeline with pass/fail thresholds and annotated failure artifacts
PR with tests reviewed and approved by at least one runtime engineer and one applied-ML reviewer
test_plan: Unit-level parsers: feed synthetic streams with preface lengths [0,5,20,40] and assert JSON extraction succeeds
End-to-end streaming: spawn runtime worker in test mode, send partial chunks that interleave tool-call markers, validate reassembly produces valid schema-conforming JSON
Constrained decoder regression: simulate token-level noise, ensure decoder fallback policies ('graceful-relax' -> 'strict-fail') behave as documented
Cross-model matrix: run scenarios against model-set [redwood-open-7b, redwood-13b-quant, community-34b] and report any model-specific quirks
Chaos scenario: inject random delimiter corruption mid-stream and assert harness captures debug traces for root-cause analysis
Performance check: ensure added test harness doesn't increase CI runtime by >10% (where applicable) and provides sharding knobs
